title: rtl-buddy-view view.json v1
description: Locked schema for the JSON hierarchy + overlay payload consumed by the rtl-buddy-view interactive web viewer (#18). Producer is rtl-buddy-view's --format json renderer. Phase 5 viewer treats this as a stable contract; consumers can rely on field presence + type per this schema for any 1.x payload.

schema_version.description: Schema version as MAJOR.MINOR. 1.x payloads are backward-compatible — minor bumps may add fields, never rename or retype them.

tool.description: Producer self-identification — purely informational; consumers don't gate on it.

nodes.description: Every elaborated instance in the hierarchy, sorted by id.

edges.description: Parent→child instantiation edges, sorted by (from, to).

overlays_present.description: Sorted list of overlay names whose annotation payloads contributed to this view. The viewer dispatches per-overlay JS modules off this list.

id.description: Stable instance path, dot-separated from the top module. Reproducible across runs given the same RTL.

module.description: Module-type name this instance refers to.

instance_name.description: Source-level instance name. null for the top node (the top isn't 'instantiated').

is_blackbox.description: True when the module wasn't found in the filelist — viewers render with a dashed border.

source.description: Source anchor for this node. May be null for synthetic / blackbox nodes the extractor never saw; real-world payloads populate this on every non-blackbox node.

ports.description: Per-port binding for THIS instance. ``expr`` is the net expression the parent connected to the port at the instantiation site.

parameters.description: Parameter overrides applied to this instance. Empty object when none. Values are verbatim source slices ('32', '"hello"', '`MAX_WIDTH').

link.description: rtlbuddy:// URI pointing the hub at this node's source anchor. Null when no source location is known (blackboxes that the extractor never saw).

overlays.description: Per-overlay metadata, keyed by overlay name. Missing keys mean no contribution; never an error.

port_pairs.description: Tuples of [net_expr_at_parent, child_port_name]. Used by the wave→view joiner (Phase 9) to trace signals across hierarchy levels.

overlays.description: Per-overlay edge metadata. ``clock.crossing: true`` marks a CDC edge; ``reset.crossing: true`` an RDC edge.

expr.description: Net expression bound to this port at instantiation. Null when no binding (the port is declared on the module but unconnected at this instance).
